simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָחַשׂ (H3187) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 20 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָחַשׂ (yâchas) means to enroll by pedigree First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 33.

definitions.usage: (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.
definitions.full: H3187. yachas [ הִתְיַחֵשׂ ] verb Hithpa`el denominative enroll oneself or be enrolled by Genealogy (Late Hebrew often in Pi`el (also Hithpa`el), Aramaic Pa`el (Ithpa`al)) — Perfect 3masculine plural הִתְיַחֲשׂוּ 1Chr 5:17 ; 9:1 ; Infinitive construct הִתְיַחֵשׂ 5:1 5 t.; suffix הִתְיִחֲשָׂם 4:33 7 t.; Participle plural הַמִּתְיִחֲשִׂים Ezra 2:62 ; Neh 7:64 ; — be enrolled by Genealogy 1Chr 5:17 ; 9:1 ; Neh 7:5 ; perhaps also ׳לְהִתְי 2Chr 12:15 (tr. to 11:16 according to Hi Be, see VB); לְהִתְי ׳וְלֹא לַבְּכֹרָה 1Chr 5:1 but he is not to be enrolled in the place of first born ; followed by בְּ ( among, of, consisting in ) 7:40 , without לְ 7:7 ; Ezra 8:1 ; ׳הִתְי הַכֹּהֲנִים 2Chr 31:17 ; Infinitive = Genealogical enrolment 1Chr 4:33 these were their dwellings and they had ( לָהֶם ) genealogical enrolment , compare 7:5 , 9 ; ׳בְּהִתְי 5:7 at the enrolment , of. ( לְ ) their Generations; הִתְיַחֲשָׂם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶם הֵמָּה 9:22 as for them, in their villages was their enrolment ; nearly = genealogical list 2Chr 31:15 ( לִזְכָרִים ; i.e. the males whose names were in the list), so Ezra 8:3 , compare 2Chr 31:18-19 , (all followed by בְּ among, of ) Participle plural with article הַמִּתְיַחֲשִׂים כְתָבָם בִּקְשׁוּ Ezra 2:62 = Neh 7:64 they sought their writing (their book), namely the enrolled , i.e. their Genealogical record. יַ֫חַת see below חתה
